dashboard.title: Welcome to GoTree
dashboard.intro: Your family tree lives on this server, in a single file you control.
dashboard.statsFailed: The tree summary could not be loaded.

onboarding.title: No one is in your tree yet
onboarding.viewerText: Ask the owner of this tree to add people.
onboarding.text: Start with yourself or the oldest ancestor you know, or bring in a tree you already have.
onboarding.import: Import from Ancestry, MyHeritage and others

auth.setupIntro: Create the administrator account. You can invite family members later.
auth.treeNameHint: For example the main family name. You can change it later.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few random words work well.
auth.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.

common.discardMessage: You have unsaved changes. If you close this form, they will be lost.
common.loadFailed: Could not load the data. Please try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts work when no text field has focus.

people.searchPlaceholder: Name, also birth or married names

person.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} with all their events? Their families stay, with this person removed.
person.livingHint: Automatic: deceased with a death record or when born more than 110 years ago.
person.pickerHint: Type a name to search the tree.

family.deleteConfirm: Delete this family with its events? The people stay in the tree, only the connection between them is removed.

event.descriptionHint: e.g. the occupation, school or cause of death
event.participantsHint: For shared records like a census household, witnesses or godparents.
event.statusHint: Keep doubtful or wrong facts instead of deleting them, with the reason.

date.hint: e.g. 12 March 1850, 12.3.1850, about 1850, between 1850 and 1860, before 1900
date.unrecognized: Not a recognized date. It is kept as typed and flagged for review.

place.hint: Search existing places, or type a new one like “Potsdam, Brandenburg, Germany”.

tree.truncated: The tree is too large to show completely; reduce the generations or center on someone else.
tree.empty: There is no one in your tree yet. Add a person first.
tree.chartHelp: Use the arrow keys to move between people: up to parents, down to children, left and right within a generation. Press Enter to select a person.
tree.rootMissing: This person is no longer in the tree.

citation.sourceHint: Search your sources, or type the title of a new one.
citation.pageHint: e.g. page 12, entry 34, or an image number

source.intro: Church books, civil records, census returns, letters, websites: where your facts come from.
source.title: Title
source.titleHint: e.g. “Church book St. Thomas Leipzig, baptisms 1880–1900”
source.author: Author or creator
source.repositoryHint: Archive, library or website. Type to search or create.
source.callNumberHint: Signature or film number at the archive

media.intro: Photos, scanned documents, letters and recordings. Tag faces and link them to people.
media.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? It is removed from everyone it is linked to.
media.drawHint: Drag a box around a face. Without a mouse or touch screen, use “Add a person” below to link someone without a box.
media.faceNameHint: If the person is not in the tree yet.
media.descriptionHint: Who, where and what is shown; also read by screen readers.
media.transcriptHint: The text of a letter or document.
media.transcriptHintAudio: What is said in the recording.

transfer.backupAllTrees: The backup holds every tree and every account on this server. To give someone a copy of one tree, export it as GEDCOM.
transfer.importIntro: GEDCOM is the exchange format of genealogy programs. Export your tree from Ancestry, MyHeritage, FamilySearch, webtrees, Gramps or RootsMagic and import it here. Nothing is lost: what GoTree does not use is kept and written back on export.
transfer.fileHint: A .ged file, or a .zip / .gdz containing one; photos and documents in the zip are imported too. GEDCOM 5.5, 5.5.1 and 7.0.
transfer.replaceWarning: Your tree already has data. Importing replaces its people, families, events, places and sources. Photos stay in the media list.
transfer.ownerOnly: Only the owner of the tree can replace it. Ask the owner to import this file.
transfer.replaceConfirm_one: This deletes the {{count}} person in your tree with everything about them and imports the file instead. Consider exporting first.
transfer.replaceConfirm_other: This deletes the {{count}} people in your tree with everything about them and imports the file instead. Consider exporting first.
transfer.importing: Importing… large files take a moment.
transfer.notEmpty: Your tree is not empty. Choose “Replace the tree” to import anyway.
transfer.invalidDates_one: {{count}} date is not in GEDCOM format
transfer.invalidDates_other: {{count}} dates are not in GEDCOM format
transfer.invalidDatesHint: They are kept as written and sorted last. You can correct them later.
transfer.brokenRefsHint: The file points to records it does not contain; these links were skipped.
transfer.famcChildren_one: {{count}} child added to a family by its INDI.FAMC line
transfer.famcChildren_other: {{count}} children added to families by their INDI.FAMC lines
transfer.famcChildrenHint: The family did not list these children (FAM.CHIL), but each child names the family (INDI.FAMC); they were added to it. Check that this is right.
transfer.replaceShareLinks_one: {{count}} share link shows one branch. It keeps working if the file has its person with the same GEDCOM ID and name; otherwise it is deleted.
transfer.replaceShareLinks_other: {{count}} share links show one branch each. A link keeps working if the file has its person with the same GEDCOM ID and name; otherwise it is deleted.
transfer.shareLinksKept_one: {{count}} share link to a branch kept: its person is in the file.
transfer.shareLinksKept_other: {{count}} share links to a branch kept: their people are in the file.
transfer.shareLinksLostHint: The file has no person with the same GEDCOM ID and name as the person whose branch these links showed. Create new links on the Sharing page.
transfer.tagsSummary: What happened to every GEDCOM tag ({{kept}} kept as is, {{dropped}} dropped)
transfer.tagsHint: Mapped tags became GoTree data. Kept tags are stored unchanged and written back when you export. Dropped tags are listed with the reason.
transfer.exportIntro: Download your tree to keep a copy, to share it, or to move it to another program.
transfer.v551Hint: Read by almost every genealogy program. Choose this when in doubt.
transfer.v7Hint: The current standard, read by FamilySearch and newer programs.
transfer.privacyNameOnly: Living people with their name only
transfer.privacyNameOnlyHint: Keeps the family connections but leaves out their dates, places, notes and photos.
transfer.privacyExcludeHint: For publishing or sharing with people you do not know.
transfer.formatZipHint: A zip with the GEDCOM file and all media files. GPS positions are removed from photos unless the server is set to keep them.
transfer.checking: Exporting and reading the file back…
transfer.checkOk: GEDCOM {{version}}: everything came back. The export is complete.
transfer.checkLoss: GEDCOM {{version}}: not everything came back. See the differences below.
transfer.checkCaption: Records in the tree and after exporting and reading back
transfer.viewerPrivacy: As a viewer you can export the tree without living people.

relationship.intro: Pick two people to see how the second is related to the first, and the line of people that connects them.
relationship.notRelated: {{a}} and {{b}} are not related through the recorded families.
relationship.pathStepSpouse: spouse or partner of the previous

quality.intro: GoTree checks the tree for dates that contradict each other and for dates it cannot read. Vague dates such as “ABT 1850” only count as a problem when every reading of them is impossible.

rule.too_old: {{person}} would have lived to at least {{years}}.
rule.living_too_old: {{person}} is marked as living but would be at least {{years}}.
rule.parent_too_young: {{person}} was born when {{other}} was at most {{years}}.
rule.mother_too_old: {{person}} was born when their mother {{other}} was at least {{years}}.
rule.born_after_mother_death: {{person}} was born after their mother {{other}} died.
rule.born_after_father_death: {{person}} was born more than a year after their father {{other}} died.
rule.invalid_date: {{person}}’s {{event}} has a date GoTree cannot read.

quality.datesIntro: Dates typed as “12.3.1850”, “ca. 1850” or “March 12, 1850” can be rewritten in the standard form other genealogy programs read. Check the list and untick anything that looks wrong.
quality.datesNone: All dates are already in the standard form.
quality.datesUnreadable_one: {{count}} date cannot be read at all; it is listed under problems found.
quality.datesUnreadable_other: {{count}} dates cannot be read at all; they are listed under problems found.
quality.skipped_one: {{count}} was skipped because it was changed meanwhile.
quality.skipped_other: {{count}} were skipped because they were changed meanwhile.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Download everything — all trees, accounts, photos and documents — as one zip file. Keep it somewhere safe; RESTORE.txt inside explains how to bring it back. A GEDCOM export is for other programs, this backup is for GoTree.

sharing.intro: A share link lets relatives browse the tree without an account. They can only look, never change anything, and living people stay private. You can withdraw a link at any time.
sharing.ownerOnly: Only the owner of the tree can share it.
sharing.label: Name
sharing.labelHint: Who it is for, e.g. “Cousins in Leipzig”. Only you see this.
sharing.scopeDescendantsHint: One person, their descendants and the partners of all of them.
sharing.privacy_living_names: Show living people by name only
sharing.privacyLivingNamesHint: Living people appear with their name, without dates, events or notes, so the family structure stays complete.
sharing.expiresOnHint: The link stops working after this day. Leave empty to keep it until you withdraw it.
sharing.createdHint: Copy the link now and send it to your relatives. For safety GoTree keeps only a fingerprint of it, so it cannot be shown again; if it gets lost, make a new address (the old one then stops working).
sharing.revokeConfirm: Withdraw “{{label}}”? Anyone using it loses access immediately. This cannot be undone; you can create a new link instead.
sharing.reissueConfirm: The current address of “{{label}}” will stop working. Send the new one to everyone who should keep access.
sharing.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.

trees.title: Your trees
trees.noTreeText: You are not working in a tree right now. Open one of your trees, create a new one, or ask the owner of a family tree to add you.

members.intro: People with an account can work in this tree. Owners manage members, editors change the tree, viewers only read it.

roleHint.owner: Manages members and sharing, can replace the tree.
roleHint.editor: Adds and changes people, sources and media.
roleHint.viewer: Only reads the tree; exports leave out living people.

members.removeMessage: {{name}} will no longer see or change this tree. Their account stays.
members.ownerOnly: Only the owners of this tree manage its members.
members.leaveMessage: You will no longer see this tree. An owner can add you again.

accounts.intro: Accounts of everyone who can log in to this server. Only administrators see this page.

roleHint.admin: Manages accounts and downloads the backup of the whole server.
roleHint.user: Works in the trees they are a member of.

accounts.createdNext: Add it to a tree on the Members page.
accounts.resetPasswordText: Sets a new password and signs this account out on all devices. Tell the person the new password in a safe way.
accounts.deleteMessage: The person can no longer log in and leaves all trees. What they entered stays in the trees.

share.moreResults: Showing the first {{shown}}; type a name to narrow it down.
share.invalidHint: It may have expired or been withdrawn. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
share.livingNamesNote: Living people are shown by name only.
share.privateDetails: Details of living people are private.

calendar.title: Calendar of birthdays and anniversaries
calendar.intro: Subscribe in your phone’s or computer’s calendar to see birthdays, wedding anniversaries and remembrance days of the family. The address is secret: anyone who has it can read these dates, so withdraw it if it gets out.
calendar.labelHint: Where you use it, e.g. “My phone”. Only you see this.
calendar.includeLivingHint: Adds birthdays of living people and anniversaries of living couples. Without it, only the deceased appear.
calendar.createdHint: Add it to your calendar app as a subscription. For safety GoTree keeps only a fingerprint of it, so it cannot be shown again later.
calendar.langHint: Calendar entries will be in the interface language (lang={{lang}}). To get another language, switch it and copy the address again.
calendar.revokeConfirm: Withdraw “{{label}}”? Calendars subscribed to it stop getting the dates.
calendar.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.

research.intro: Keep track of what you still want to find out, and of every search — including the ones that found nothing, so you do not search the same register twice.
research.deleteTaskConfirm: Delete the task “{{title}}”? Its log entries stay, without the task.
research.title: What to find out
research.result_not_foundHint: Worth recording: the next search can go elsewhere.
research.result_partialHint: Some of it, or something that needs checking.
research.suggestion_missing_birth: Find a record of {{name}}’s birth or baptism
research.suggestion_missing_death: Find a record of {{name}}’s death or burial

transcribe.intro: Start from the record: copy a census page, a baptism or a marriage entry into a grid, match each person to the tree, and GoTree creates the people, the event and the citations, each fact pointing to its line.
transcribe.title: Title
transcribe.titleHint: e.g. “Census 1900, Leipzig, Hainstraße 3”; required for other records
transcribe.notesHint: The text as written; it is kept with the citation.
transcribe.matchesFound: Matches checked. Choose who each person is.
transcribe.noMatches: No similar person in the tree.
transcribe.applyHint: Creates the new people, the event and the citations. The transcription cannot be changed afterwards.
transcribe.deleteConfirm: Delete this transcription? What it added to the tree stays.
transcribe.templatesIntro: For records the built-in templates do not cover, such as school registers or passenger lists.
transcribe.appliedMessage: Added to the tree: the event, {{facts}} and {{people}}.

chart.title: Wall chart
chart.intro: Print the tree on paper up to A0, or save it as a PDF or SVG. Choose a person, the kind of chart and the paper; the chart is fitted to the page.
chart.pickRoot: Choose a person to start the chart.
chart.tooSmall: Names will be printed in {{pt}} pt, which is hard to read. Choose larger paper or fewer generations.

heirloom.intro: Objects handed down in the family — a watch, a chest, a family Bible — with who held them and how they got them.
heirloom.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its photos stay in the media list.
heirloom.name: Name
heirloom.notInTreeHint: Say who in the notes, e.g. “sold to a dealer in Halle”.

stats.intro: Figures about the people in the tree. Each chart has the numbers next to it.
stats.empty: Not enough dates yet for this.
stats.lifespanCaption: Average age at death of people born in each decade; the range shows the youngest and the oldest.
stats.marriageCaption: Average age at the first marriage of men and women, and at later marriages, by decade of birth.
stats.childrenCaption: How many families have how many children; on average {{average}}.
stats.surnamesCaption: The most common surnames; the larger the name, the more people have it.
stats.givenNamesCaption: The most common first given names, and the three most common per decade of birth.
stats.name: Name

map.intro: Watch where the family lived over time. People appear at the places of their dated events — birth, residences, census, emigration, marriage, death — and move on with each event.
map.unmapped_one: {{count}} event is at a place without coordinates and cannot be shown; add the coordinates on the place.
map.unmapped_other: {{count}} events are at places without coordinates and cannot be shown; add the coordinates on the place.
map.approximate: approximate: coordinates of an enclosing place
map.none: No dated events at places with coordinates yet.
map.noneWhy: GEDCOM files rarely carry coordinates and GoTree does not look them up by itself, so places need coordinates before they can appear on the map.
map.noneMissing_one: {{count}} place used by dated events has no coordinates.
map.noneMissing_other: {{count}} places used by dated events have no coordinates.
map.missingTruncated: {{total}} places lack coordinates; showing the {{shown}} busiest.
map.missingIntro: Enter latitude and longitude for a place, or look it up. Places inside a place with coordinates are shown there, approximately. The busiest places come first.
map.lookupPrivacy: "Look up on OpenStreetMap" sends the name of that one place and the address of this server to nominatim.openstreetmap.org when you click it. Nothing is looked up automatically.
map.coordsBoth: Enter both latitude and longitude as numbers.
map.lookupFailed: OpenStreetMap could not be reached. Enter the coordinates by hand instead.
map.lookupNone: OpenStreetMap found no match for this place.
map.lookupAttribution: Results © OpenStreetMap contributors (Nominatim). Check that the match is the right place, then save.
map.attribution: Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors; loading them sends a request to openstreetmap.org.
map.mapLabel: Map of where people lived in {{year}}
map.legendApproximate: Place shown at an enclosing place
map.legendTrail: Moves so far; older ones fade

account.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. You were signed out on your other devices.
account.sessionsIntro: A session ends 30 days after it was last used, and at the latest 90 days after logging in.
account.signOutEverywhereMessage: All sessions end, including this one, and you will need to log in again.

apiError.invalid_json: The request was not valid JSON.
apiError.trailing_data: The request contains extra data after the JSON.
apiError.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
apiError.still_in_use: This is still in use and cannot be removed.
apiError.owner_only: Only the owner of the tree can do this.
apiError.transcription_applied: The transcription was applied and can no longer change.
apiError.invalid_scope: The scope must be all, ancestors or descendants.
apiError.entity_id_required: An ID is required together with the kind of record.
apiError.not_member: You are not a member of any tree.
apiError.view_only: You can only view this tree.
apiError.too_many_logins: Too many failed logins, try again later.
apiError.setup_done: GoTree has already been set up.
apiError.admin_only_backup: Only administrators can download a backup.
apiError.last_admin: The last administrator cannot be deleted or made a regular user.
apiError.last_owner: A tree needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
apiError.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
apiError.reset_own_password: Change your own password on your account page.
apiError.export_living_editors: Only owners and editors can export living people. Choose an export without living people.
apiError.share_gone: This link does not exist, has expired or was withdrawn.
apiError.invalid_upload: The upload could not be read.
apiError.no_file: There is no file in the upload.
apiError.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{limitMB}} MB.
apiError.upload_timeout: The upload took too long; check the connection and try again.
apiError.request_too_large: The request is too large (over {{limitKB}} KB).
apiError.request_timeout: The request took too long to arrive; check the connection and try again.
apiError.unsupported_media: This kind of file is not supported; use JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, PDF, MP3, M4A, OGG, WAV, MP4 or WebM.
apiError.image_too_large: The image is larger than {{megapixels}} megapixels.
apiError.file_missing: The file is missing on the server.
apiError.thumbnail_too_large: The image is too large to render a thumbnail.
apiError.media_prepare_failed: The file could not be prepared for download.
apiError.replace_owner_only: Only the owner of the tree can replace it; editors can import into an empty tree.
apiError.gedcom_too_large: The GEDCOM file is too large (over {{limitMB}} MB).
apiError.gedcom_invalid: The GEDCOM file could not be read.
apiError.gedcom_not_gedcom: This does not look like a GEDCOM file (line {{line}}).
apiError.gedcom_zip_unreadable: The zip file could not be read.
apiError.gedcom_zip_no_ged: The zip file contains no .ged file.
apiError.gedcom_zip_several_ged: The zip file contains several .ged files; upload the one you want.
apiError.export_check_busy: An export check is already running. Try again in a moment.

field.date_in_past: must not be in the past
field.invalid_url: must start with http:// or https://
field.self_reference: a person or place cannot refer to itself
field.cycle: this would make a person their own ancestor
field.username_format: use 2–64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores
field.coords_together: latitude and longitude must be given together
field.reason_required: say why it is disputed or disproven
field.family_choice: choose one of this person's families
field.date_out_of_range: month and day are out of range
field.not_canonical_date: item {{item}} is not a canonical GEDCOM date
field.invalid_tag: must be a GEDCOM tag such as BIRT, or a custom tag starting with _
field.name_part_required: a name needs at least a given name, surname or nickname
field.record_title: name the kind of record, e.g. “School register”
field.pick_source: pick the source the record comes from
field.person_or_new: give either an existing person or a new one
field.parents_known: both parents in this family are already known
field.event_owner: an event belongs to exactly one person or one family
field.family_event: this event belongs to a family
field.living_no_death: a living person has no death
field.place_comma: must not contain a comma; use the parent place for the larger region
field.holder_required: name the holder: pick a person or say who in the notes
field.not_face_tag: is not a face tag on this photo
field.outside_image: the box must lie within the image
field.citation_not_attached: a citation is not attached here
field.roles_invalid: the roles of the event are not valid
field.rows_invalid: the record needs both partners and exactly one row with the main role
field.name_length_one: give a name of at most {{count}} character
field.name_length_other: give a name of at most {{count}} characters
field.text_length_one: say it in at most {{count}} character
field.text_length_other: say it in at most {{count}} characters
field.too_many_rows_one: a record can have at most {{count}} row
field.too_many_rows_other: a record can have at most {{count}} rows
